b66ec66e.author: Isaiah Martin
b66ec66e.subject: - Editors: Insert and Settings tabs have a Favorites section at the top. Starred items stay in their own section, and starred snippets are listed first in autocomplete with a ★ - Editors: new Keyboard Shortcuts section in Settings. Built-in hotkeys can be rebound, and any setting can get a hotkey that turns it on and off or opens it - Editors: quick-type keys can be added or removed per snippet. Quick typing an item with parameters selects the first parameter like autocomplete - Editors: custom snippets are the last category in the Insert tab and are offered in autocomplete. Like built-ins, they store a type (Text, Function, Macro, Variable or Unit), parameters, return type and example - Editors: "Save as Custom Snippet" in the Variables tab and the editor's right-click menu fills in the snippet from a definition and its metadata comment, or from the selected text - Editors: hotkeys and quick-type keys that conflict with existing ones can't be saved - Default keybindings and quick types now live in settings.default.json so they save and reset with presets - VS Code: keybinding changes are mirrored into the user's keybindings.json, which is left alone if it has syntax errors

c18e7fd9.author: Isaiah Martin
c18e7fd9.subject: - Editors: UI Overrides in the Properties tab has "Override Defaults", which writes values for #UI lines in this file (outside loops, macros and includes) into the source and removes them from the overrides - Editors: "Revert to defaults" removes the listed overrides so those controls use their default values - Editors: new "Auto-Sync #UI Values" setting (off by default). For #UI lines in this file outside loops, macros and includes, input form values are written into the #UI line, and editing a line's value removes its override. - Editors: the Properties tab shows how many changes are pending above Apply and Reset, and each section gets its own Apply and Reset buttons. - Desktop: the hidden metadata footer no longer reappears in the editor after saving #UI values - Updating docs
